text: City Council on January 31 and February 1, 2018 established a Compliance Audit Committee Nominating Panel for the 2018 election composed of three Members of Council, Councillor Paula Fletcher, Councillor Jim Hart and Councillor Lucy Troisi. The Members of the Nominating Panel shall elect a Chair.
The Nominating Panel: 1. Elected Councillor Jim Hart as Chair of the Compliance Audit Committee Nominating Panel.
